caption_L1: Mobility in selected cities between March 3 , 2020 and December 7 , 2020 , compared with movement prior to the coronavirus outbreak is a line graph. On the x-axis, Response is plotted on a categorical scale from April to October. Along the y-axis, Stockholm is plotted using a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0.
caption_L2L3: Between March and about mid-May/early June movement reduced to around 40% of pre-pandemic levels, throughout the summer seasons movement began to grow but remained at around 75% pre-pandemic levels, during the winter months movement began to fall again but not as low as the intial fall at the beginning of the pandemic.
